# Cap/floor volatility surface (`cap-vol-surface` v1)

Cap vols by maturity and strike.

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `CPV` · **Identifiers:** `CPV-…` in `surfaceId`

Open one with `CPV <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: cap-vol-surface
version: 1
description: Cap vols by maturity and strike.
match: { kind: cap-vol-surface, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · Cap/floor volatility surface, id: $.surfaceId }
strip:
  - { label: Currency, bind: $.currency }
  - { label: "5Y ATM", bind: $.atm5y, fmt: price2, emphasis: true }
panels:
  - id: surface
    kind: surface
    title: Cap vols by maturity × strike (bp)
    code: SURF
    key: F4
    rows: $.grid
    y: maturity
    columns:
      - { label: ATM, bind: "@.atm", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "2%", bind: "@.k2", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "3%", bind: "@.k3", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "4%", bind: "@.k4", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "5%", bind: "@.k5", fmt: price2 }
  - id: grid
    kind: table
    title: Cap vols (bp)
    key: F2
    rows: $.grid
    columns:
      - { label: Maturity, bind: "@.maturity" }
      - { label: ATM, bind: "@.atm", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "2%", bind: "@.k2", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "3%", bind: "@.k3", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "4%", bind: "@.k4", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "5%", bind: "@.k5", fmt: price2 }
  - id: atm
    kind: line
    title: ATM by maturity
    area: right
    rows: $.grid
    x: maturity
    y: atm
    fmt: price2
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
keys: { F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
